name: publish_release
title: Publish a repository release
description: Tag a merged commit and create its public GitHub release (`summary`, the cards merged since the last one). `preview: true` is open to the deployment duty; publishing is only the owner’s or their connected Claude’s (release_owner_only). After release_publish_failed, call it again.

summary.description: English markdown: what the release changes, as short bullets with the card keys. It starts the text of the GitHub release; the card list is added.

repo.description: The repository name in the project; default: the only repository (required with several).

commit.description: A merge commit of a merged card; default: the head of the default branch.

tag.description: The tag name; default: vYYYY.M.D of today, with .2, .3 … when the day has more releases.

preview.description: Only show the tag, the commit and the cards, to write the summary; record and send nothing (default false).
